title: Initiative on the map
summary: An Initiative panel on the map shows the round and turn order without leaving the battle map.
items: Dungeon Masters see the encounter's round, turn order and hit points, and can step Previous turn or Next turn; the full tracker is one tap away.
Players in a shared campaign see the round, whose turn it is, the combatants revealed on the map and their own character's hit points, and nothing the DM keeps hidden.
Press I to open or close it.
